claims.subject: flow_008_intAndExc_i_driveFromWB
claims.explanation: The flow starts with i_driveFromWB, which fans out to two initial mergers (WbMerge and WbtopcMerge). The merged output from WbMerge feeds into inOutSele, which splits the event into two paths: one to an internal stack (u_inStack) and one to the outStack (u_outStack). The outStack produces two of the three output endpoints (o_driveToWGRF_1 and o_driveToWPSR_1). The third endpoint (o_driveToDataRoute_1) is produced by dataRoteMerge, which merges outputs from the inStack, outStack, and the WbtopcMerge path. The flow also includes a feedback loop via SRMerge and intAndExeSele, which can re-inject events back into the flow through preStackSpli.

claims.subject: inOutSele

This is a critical branch point that determines whether the event goes to the internal stack (u_inStack) or the outStack (u_outStack).
